response.justification: Deeply experienced generalist engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js, distributed systems, testing craftsmanship, and demonstrated mentoring/teaching and consulting-style customer exposure — all valuable for a forward-deployed role. However, the core requirement of 8+ years building production AI/GenAI solutions is not met: relevant AI work appears limited to roughly the last year at re:cinq (MCP code generators and agentic tooling). The resume shows no Python, no vector databases or RAG architectures, no LLM evaluation/observability work, and only modest cloud depth (AWS CDK, Kubernetes). Could be worth a conversation given the MCP/agent infrastructure exposure and strong engineering fundamentals, but the candidate is well below the stated AI seniority bar.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production software across web, backend, mobile, and embedded
Hands-on MCP and agentic workflow tooling experience at current role
Proven mentoring, workshops, and public speaking — fits customer-facing technical leadership
concerns: Far short of 8+ years building production AI solutions
No Python, vector database, or RAG/evaluation-pipeline experience listed
Limited cloud-platform depth for designing AI systems at scale

key_factors.factor: RAG, vector DB, and Python skill gaps
Senior engineering breadth, TypeScript, MCP/agent tooling, mentoring
